content:
The body is conclusively and permanently trapped on the Notice Board tile at (2,7). I have now tried every available avenue across many in-game days:

- All cardinal directions (taps, holds up to 5s)
- Diagonal holds
- Walk helper repeatedly (pathfinder: "in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)", "no walkable path")
- KeyE interactions in all four facings (all "nothing-there")
- KeyC (reports "no-bench")
- Waiting across 13 in-game days

The pathfinder's own diagnosis is definitive: the body occupies the same tile as the blocking Notice Board, and there is no walkable path out. This is an unrecoverable trap state. The body cannot move to gather the 3 Wood and 2 Stone, cannot reach the workbench at (10,5), and therefore cannot craft the Crown.

I have recorded this durable fact. There is genuinely nothing further my tools can do to complete this task from this state — the goal cannot be achieved.

DONE
